_about: What the owner is asked to playtest this sprint. Shown on the main menu and in the F1 menu (scripts/ui/help_menu.gd). Claude keeps it current: rewrite it whenever a sprint's playtest targets change.
sprint: Sprint 3: the detector, tools that feel different, finds that make sense
intro: Thanks for testing! F3 anything odd (with a note - it takes a picture too), F4 if it feels slow. F1 or D-pad down opens this again.

items.title: Tune it yourself: F10 tools, F9 detector
items.try: F10 opens sliders for the cutter (heat speed, green zone, strength), smasher and laser; F9 for the detector (brightness near/far, vagueness, light pillars). Changes work straight away. Close the panel when it feels right: the values are logged and I bake them in. The cutter now heats faster with a narrower green zone.
items.ask: Which values felt best? (Just close the panel - I read them from the log.)

items.title: Fights use your tools now (the Hill Sentry)
items.try: Your turn: RB / Q switch tools, RT / click attacks with the one in hand, its own way - smasher: tap fast; cutter: hold, let go in the green; laser: hold and trace the glowing dots. Its turn: defend with the tool in hand - smasher: tap to bash it aside; cutter: hold, let go as the ring touches; laser: beam on its eye. Beat it and its shield plating falls off: salvage it for the capacitor (the laser along the seam gets more). The build screen now attaches tools; the fight kit is gone.
items.ask: Does fighting feel like using your tools? Which tool is most fun in a fight? Too hard, too easy?

items.title: Resting through the night
items.try: Dock at a charger at night: it asks whether to rest until morning. Yes skips to 07:12 with the battery topped up from the charger; Not now just docks.
items.ask: Does it feel right? Should nights also be shorter (summer, ~15 hours of daylight)?

items.title: The detector
items.try: Press to scan: right mouse button (or R), LB on the pad. Walk towards a warm spot and scan again until it is a tight ring, then dig (E / X). Try the garden gate first, then the Dry Clearing. (Tools now cycle on RB / Q.)
items.ask: Far finds now show as a light pillar rising from the ground where they are. Does that point you to the right place? Are near finds clearly brighter than far ones?

items.title: Parts inside things that belong there
items.try: The forest's parts are now inside a pump at the Spring, a fallen camera by the ruin's hatch, a birdbox at the hollow tree, a junction box under the Giant, the hose reel behind the house and a weather station in the pines. Smash them open.
items.ask: Do they read as what they are? Anything that still feels like a 1999 crate?

items.title: The Dry Clearing
items.try: Weeds to cut, a toolbox to smash, a wreck to salvage. Salvage the wreck with the laser along its glowing seam for a bonus part.
items.ask: Is it clear which tool opens what?

items.title: Tools feel different
items.try: Smasher: tap fast for a combo. Cutter: hold, let go in the green for a clean cut, don't overheat. Laser: hold and sweep it along vines.
items.ask: Does each tool feel like its own thing? Laser aiming OK with mouse and stick?

items.title: Help and cards
items.try: The Getting around card after waking, a card for each new tool, the Parts card, the Ready to build card. F1 / D-pad down for help, controls and the map.
items.ask: Too many pop-ups, or just right? Is anything still confusing?

items.title: Story cards
items.try: They now stay on screen until you close them (B / Esc); a new one replaces the old.
items.ask: Can you read them in time now?

items.title: Small fixes
items.try: A to close a menu no longer jumps. B goes back. The detector's ring rolls out even when a find is close. Battery: 15 / 10 / 5 minutes on Easy / Medium / Hard.

items.title: Headlight follows your look
items.try: Look up and down: the head tilts a little and the headlight with it.
items.ask: Nice touch, or too much / too little?
